items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: when we were there mostly Smiley and Joe, we had the quartet. ... Smiley and Joe played guitar.

ctx.x: And I helped by just talking for him. Jim used to come to the red carpet. Joe Wright owned the red carpet club. That was where I first met Jim. And Jim called me not too long ago and asked me, he says, he's divorced from his wife. He says, I am in love with a girl that I have known since I was a little fellow. And he says, her favorite is close as pages in a book. All right. He says, do you know that? I said, no. But let me look and I'll see. Jim was almost ready to go on his bench. Well, Jim was almost ready to…
That's nearly all of it out of a thousand in this book, I guess.
